label: Display-only no-lump outline gate (does not change served weights)
disclaimer: Research demo. Not for clinical use. Display option only.

selection.rule: Hide outline when peak soft-mask value is below a threshold. Chosen to clear the most normal false outlines on validation without dropping lesion Dice by more than 0.01.

busbra.note: Outside per-image files lack soft-mask max, so this confidence gate was not re-applied case-by-case without the image archive.

breast.note: Outside per-image files lack soft-mask max, so this confidence gate was not re-applied case-by-case without the image archive.

busuclm_note: BUS-UCLM per-image soft masks are not in the repo, so this display gate was not re-scored there. Aggregate false outlines on normal scans remain 320/413 without applying the gate.
plain_summary: Hide the outline when the model’s strongest outline pixel is below 0.960 (chosen on BUSI validation). Default on. Test lesion Dice drop within 0.01; toggle defaults on.
